description: NaNb₃O₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmmn space group. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₅ square pyramids. There is one shorter (2.29 Å) and four longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.32 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.48 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Nb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to four Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Nb atoms.
